skill.displayName: 微信公众号自定义主题生成器
skill.summary: AI-ready skill to design and generate highly customized CSS themes for WeChat Official Accounts.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the WeChat Official Account custom CSS theme generator skill.
- Enables AI-driven generation of highly customized, namespace-compliant CSS themes for WeChat using natural language input.
- Ensures all generated CSS strictly uses the `#wenyan` prefix for full compatibility with WeChat's DOM structure.
- Supports advanced effects such as pseudo-elements, gradients, and inline SVG/Base64 backgrounds.
- Enforces best practices: no custom fonts, safe external resource linking, and guided font size ranges.
- Includes a detailed reference and CSS template for easier and more accurate theme creation.
